name: agentfem
description: The official MCP interface for the AgentFEM finite-element platform.
long_description: Connect a compatible desktop agent to an installed AgentFEM runtime through seven typed tools for creating, validating, running, inspecting, and verifying finite-element projects. AgentFEM remains the scientific engine and keeps models and results on the user's machine.

tools.name: describe_system
tools.description: Inspect the installed AgentFEM runtime and its compact capability map.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project from a version-matched official AgentFEM template.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Run fail-closed structural and compatibility checks before solving.

tools.name: inspect_project
tools.description: Read project validation and recent immutable run identities.

tools.name: submit_run
tools.description: Start a finite-element run and return a durable job identity.

tools.name: get_run_status
tools.description: Read progress and available execution evidence for a submitted run.

tools.name: get_result_summary
tools.description: Read the structured scientific result and its explicit trust state.

project_root.title: AgentFEM project folder
project_root.description: The only folder this connection may use for AgentFEM projects and results.
